name: Usap Skills
description: 66 LLM security agent skills for the Unified Security Agent Platform (USAP). Covers threat detection, incident response, red team operations, cloud security, identity risk, compliance mapping, DevSecOps, and AI security. Use any skill standalone or as part of a USAP orchestration chain.
longDescription:
Ships **6 skills**, **1 agent**, **1 command** and **3 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (6): `usap-alex` (Universal USAP security advisor (cs-security-analyst)), `usap-ciso` (CISO and executive security advisor (cs-ciso-advisor)), `usap-devsecops` (DevSecOps pipeline security engineer (cs-devsecops-engineer)), `usap-incident-responder` (Active incident command and response (cs-incident-responder)), `usap-program-manager` (Security program manager and passive lifecycle orchestrator (cs-security-program-manager)), `usap-red-teamer` (Offensive security coordinator (cs-red-teamer))
- **Agents** (1): `CLAUDE`
- **Commands** (1): `usap`
- **MCP servers** (3): `usap-splunk`, `usap-github`, `usap-slack`

Installs with `claude plugin install usap-skills@claude-community` from `jaskaranhundal/usap-skills`.
